display_boundary: The real local model selects guidance/fact/step/action IDs. Displayed language is a trusted static registry plus exact recorded state and registered next steps. Free generated legal or flight instructions are rejected. Acute incident requests use labelled deterministic procedure guidance without a model.
action_boundary: Only explicitly requested personal tasks, incomplete draft cases and bounded internal preparation workflows; current actor, tenant, role, context snapshot, rule version, preview checksum, expiry and both expected versions are checked. The model cannot confirm an action. No external correspondence, authority submission, permission, aircraft command, provider activation, reservation or dispatch action.
privacy: Current API and worker enforce actor and tenant privacy for conversations, messages, actions, tasks and reply jobs; audit payloads contain IDs/status/checksums rather than conversation text.
